anchors.anchor: Of course, the Executives are definitely not expecting me.
Context clues, though, suggest it’s not happy to see us.
“Yes, I am supposed to be here,” Daniel insists.
Even in the waiting room of the Executive Suite.
My lips are pressed to his cheek.
I have no idea what this creature is saying.
“They are expecting me.” A lie, of course.
